learning.title: A comment or wording edit to a digested Paper input stales its pinned identity; repin value-only
learning.trigger: A cleanup edits a comment, path string or wording inside a file listed in the `source.inputs` of a Paper source identity: the K-0 profile in `docs/technical-design/worker-readiness/source-profile.json`, or `source` in `paper-baselines.json` and the `*-baselines.json` files under `docs/technical-design/ui-baselines`.
learning.mistake: The public-contribution cleanup reworded four `originalPath` strings in `docs/technical-design/worker-readiness/paper-manifest.json` and one comment in `packages/ui/scripts/render-settings-references.mjs`. Each identity that hashes those bytes went stale: K-0 (`cce115a3` to `1934f697`), worker-dark (`dca98515` to `ea0cfd5c`) and settings (`c267d12b` to `3f2e4e8e`). Pull request CI never runs the Paper lanes, so main went red on the push: `ui / architecture rules and debt` failed 42 of 56 profile cases and `ui / paper parity artifacts` failed at `render:paper:worker-dark -- --check`.
learning.rule: Before merging an edit under any `source.inputs` path, list every identity that hashes it (`grep -rl "<path>" docs/technical-design/ui-baselines docs/technical-design/worker-readiness/source-profile.json`) and run `pnpm ui:architecture:test` plus `node scripts/render-worker-dark-references.mjs --check` and `node scripts/render-settings-references.mjs --check` from `packages/ui`. For a wording-only edit, repin value-only: K-0 by replacing its digest, revision prefix and per-case `sourceDigest` and `sourceIdentity` in `source-profile.json` and `paper-baselines.json` (precedents `98c8a445`, `6d7c6e9d`), the others with `render:paper:worker-dark -- --write` and `render:paper:settings -- --write`. Check that no `.png` changed. If another open branch already carries the K-0 repin, take its two files byte for byte so both merge. Never edit a test, a floor or an input list to accept a new digest.

verification.requirement: `pnpm ui:architecture:test` exits 0 and both `--check` commands exit 0; `git diff --name-only` lists no `.png` file.
